column1: # PostgreSQL 17.12 token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for each
# terminal of gram.y, which declares its tokens by name alone. Sources, all at the
# REL_17_12 tag: src/backend/parser/scan.l, the lexer; src/backend/parser/parser.c,
# the filter between it and the grammar (base_yylex); src/include/parser/kwlist.h,
# the keyword table. The lexical rules are documented at
# A token has one form here. The other forms scan.l reads (dollar quoting, E'' and
# U&'' strings, quoted and U&"" identifiers, the numeric forms, nested comments)
# are the suite:lexer rows of pg/parser/testdata/compat.tsv, and the psql
# metacommands pg/parser reads as comments (lexer.go, internal/metacmd) are its
# (unreachable) is a token the lexer never hands the grammar of a statement, so the
# alternatives that need it get no generated row.
# Literals, operators and the tokens the filter forms from other text.

column3: scan.l {identifier}: folded to lower case, so a is itself
scan.l {xuistart}, U&"...": base_yylex turns it into IDENT before the grammar reads it
scan.l {xusstart}, U&'...': base_yylex turns it into SCONST before the grammar reads it
scan.l {operator}: any run of operator characters that is no token of its own
base_yylex: NOT before BETWEEN, IN, LIKE, ILIKE or SIMILAR
base_yylex: NULLS before FIRST or LAST
base_yylex: WITH before TIME or ORDINALITY
